gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: During the period, the managing agent refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin to determine the appropriate level of margin in reserves and updating the calculation methodology behind the provision for future claims handling expenses. These changes have been accounted for prospectively as a change in estimate. As a result of these changes, GBP 1,285.7k of reserves were released in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).
gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3622 reported a net release of GBP 1.2857 million in prior year reserves for 2023. This favourable development was primarily driven by a refinement in the managing agent's methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revisions to actuarial methodology and future claims handling expenses. The 2021 year of account also closed with a favourable movement in claims reserve, contributing to a 16.5% return on capacity. The syndicate underwrites life insurance (90%) and life reinsurance (10%).

gemini-2.5-flash.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported as a net figure of reinsurance; gross figure not explicitly available. The gross premium mix is derived from the 'Concentration of insurance risk' by type of business, not explicitly 'gross premiums written by class'. The claims development triangles provided are run-off triangles for ultimate losses, not standard cumulative incurred claims triangles, and thus cannot be used to calculate prior year development using the diagonal method.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate had opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 16.611m at 1 January 2023. During 2023 management made refinements to actuarial methodologies and the provision for future claims handling expenses which were treated as a change in estimate and resulted in a net release of reserves of GBP 1.286m (net of reinsurance), representing an approximate 7.7% favourable movement relative to opening gross claims. No gross prior-year movement amount was disclosed; the release quoted is net of reinsurance.

Segmental/regulatory premium breakdown was not present in the provided excerpts, so a single 'Life insurance' class has been used.
